'use strict';
__ORIGIN__
// __NAME_TEXT__ (__BASE_TEXT__). Generated by tools/source-lab.js (generate) from the Keyoapp template of the project: the site is built on the
// Keyoapp reader theme (its first version, server-rendered pages): the series page lists every title in one page, a title page lists its
// chapters, and a chapter page names its pictures by a short id that is joined to the host the page's own script gives. Nothing was copied
// from another app. What the generator measured on the site is in the header of the generated report, not in this file.

const cheerio = require('cheerio');
const { fetchText } = require('../../server/modules/network/fetch-utils');
const { normalizeStatus } = require('../../server/modules/common/manga-status');
const { proxyImageUrl: proxyImg } = require('../../server/modules/common/image-proxy');

const BASE = __BASE__;
const SITE = __NAME__;
const GENRE_SLUGS = __GENRE_SLUGS__; // lower-case genre name -> the value the site's own genre filter (and every title's tags) uses
const NEVER_GENRE_SLUGS = __NEVER_SLUGS__; // the site's own never-listed genres: their titles are kept out of every list
const PER_PAGE = 24;
// Categories that are never listed. Matched at the start of each word, so a rename or a multi-word name is caught too.
const NEVER_LISTED_RE = /(^|[^a-z])(loli|shota|toddler)/i;
const MANGA_ID_RE = /^[\w-]+$/;
const CHAPTER_ID_RE = /^[\w-]+$/;
const INDEX_TTL = 30 * 60 * 1000;
const NAME_OF_SLUG = Object.fromEntries(Object.entries(GENRE_SLUGS).map(([name, slug]) => [String(slug).toLowerCase(), name.replace(/(^|\s)\S/g, (c) => c.toUpperCase())]));

// A chapter the site keeps for subscribers or for later: not a missing chapter, and not readable.
const LOCKED_RE = /\b(locked|unlock|premium|paywall|early access|members only|vip)\b/i;

function httpError(message, statusCode) {
  const e = new Error(message);
  e.statusCode = statusCode;
  return e;
}

function empty() {
  return { results: [], hasNextPage: false };
}

// One request where 404 is a normal answer: no retries (guide, section 3).
async function fetchPage(path) {
  let html;
  try {
    html = await fetchText(`${BASE}${path}`, 0);
  } catch (err) {
    if (/^HTTP 404$/.test(err.message)) throw httpError('not found', 404);
    throw new Error(`${SITE}: ${err.message}`, { cause: err });
  }
  if (/<title>\s*Just a moment/i.test(html)) throw new Error('the site asked for an anti-bot check (known limit)');
  return html;
}

function absUrl(u = '') {
  const s = String(u).trim();
  if (!s || /^data:/i.test(s)) return '';
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return s;
  if (s.startsWith('//')) return `https:${s}`;
  return BASE + (s.startsWith('/') ? s : `/${s}`);
}

// The picture of a card or a title page is the background of an element: url(...) in its style.
function backgroundOf($el) {
  const take = (style) => { const m = /url\(\s*['"]?([^'")]+)/.exec(style || ''); return m ? absUrl(m[1]) : ''; };
  return take($el.attr('style')) || take($el.find('[style*="url("]').first().attr('style'));
}

function plainText(html) {
  const once = cheerio.load(`<div>${html || ''}</div>`).text();
  return once.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

// "3 days ago" -> ISO date (minutes, hours, days only: coarser units are not a publication date). Else a real date, else null.
function toIso(text, now = Date.now()) {
  const s = String(text || '').trim();
  const rel = s.match(/^(\d+)\s*(second|minute|min|hour|day)s?\s*ago$/i);
  if (rel) {
    const unit = { second: 1000, minute: 60000, min: 60000, hour: 3600000, day: 86400000 }[rel[2].toLowerCase()];
    return new Date(now - Number(rel[1]) * unit).toISOString();
  }
  const t = /ago$/i.test(s) ? NaN : Date.parse(s);
  return Number.isFinite(t) && t <= now + 2 * 86400000 ? new Date(t).toISOString() : null;
}

// If 4 or more chapters share the same UTC hour it is not a publication time: null (never an invented date).
function cleanPublishDates(timestamps) {
  const perHour = new Map();
  const ms = timestamps.map((t) => Date.parse(t));
  ms.forEach((t) => { if (Number.isFinite(t)) perHour.set(Math.floor(t / 3600000), (perHour.get(Math.floor(t / 3600000)) || 0) + 1); });
  return ms.map((t) => (!Number.isFinite(t) || perHour.get(Math.floor(t / 3600000)) > 3 ? null : new Date(t).toISOString()));
}

// The text next to a label on a title page ("Status" -> "ongoing"): the label sits in a span, its value in the next block.
function valueOf($, label) {
  const span = $('span').filter((_, x) => $(x).text().trim().toLowerCase() === label.toLowerCase()).first();
  return span.length ? span.parent().next().text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : '';
}

// ---- the list of every title, read once and kept ---------------------------------------------------------------------
let seriesCache = null; // { t, items, byId }

function parseSeries($) {
  const items = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  $('#searched_series_page > button').each((_, el) => {
    const $el = $(el);
    const a = $el.find('a[href*="/series/"]').first();
    const m = String(a.attr('href') || '').match(/\/series\/([^/?#]+)/);
    const id = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
    if (!id || seen.has(id) || !MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) return;
    const type = String($el.attr('data-type') || '').toLowerCase();
    if (type === 'novel') return;
    let tags = [];
    try { tags = JSON.parse(String($el.attr('tags') || '[]').replace(/___/g, "'")); } catch (_) { tags = []; }
    tags = (Array.isArray(tags) ? tags : []).map((t) => String(t).trim().toLowerCase()).filter(Boolean);
    if (tags.some((t) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(t) || NEVER_GENRE_SLUGS.includes(t))) return;
    seen.add(id);
    const cover = backgroundOf($el);
    const title = String($el.attr('title') || a.attr('title') || '').replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || id;
    items.push({ id, title, cover: cover ? proxyImg(cover) : '', url: `${BASE}/series/${id}/`, genres: tags.map((t) => NAME_OF_SLUG[t] || t), tags, status: normalizeStatus($el.attr('data-status')), author: '' });
  });
  return items;
}

async function seriesIndex() {
  if (seriesCache && Date.now() - seriesCache.t < INDEX_TTL) return seriesCache;
  const $ = cheerio.load(await fetchPage('/series'));
  if (!$('#searched_series_page').length) throw new Error(`${SITE}: the series page has an unexpected shape`);
  const items = parseSeries($);
  seriesCache = { t: Date.now(), items, byId: new Map(items.map((i) => [i.id, i])) };
  return seriesCache;
}

// The newest-updated order of the site's own "latest" page (titles that are not in the series list, such as novels, are left out).
async function latestItems() {
  const index = await seriesIndex();
  const $ = cheerio.load(await fetchPage('/latest/'));
  const ordered = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  $('div.grid > div.group').each((_, el) => {
    const m = String($(el).find('a[href*="/series/"]').first().attr('href') || '').match(/\/series\/([^/?#]+)/);
    const id = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
    if (id && !seen.has(id) && index.byId.has(id)) { seen.add(id); ordered.push(index.byId.get(id)); }
  });
  return ordered;
}

const strip = (item) => { const { tags: _tags, ...card } = item; return card; };

function paged(items, page) {
  const p = Math.max(1, Number(page) || 1);
  const slice = items.slice((p - 1) * PER_PAGE, p * PER_PAGE);
  return { results: slice.map(strip), hasNextPage: items.length > p * PER_PAGE };
}

module.exports = {
  meta: {
    id: __ID__, name: __NAME__, version: '1.0.0', author: 'generated',
    supportsPopularAllTime: false,
    supportsRecentlyAdded: false,
    ui: {
      filters: {
        orderBy: [
          { value: 'relevance', label: 'Latest Updated' },
          { value: 'title', label: 'Name A-Z' },
        ],
        publicationStatus: false,
        contentRating: false,
        format: false,
        genres: true,
      },
      genres: __GENRES__,
      nsfwGenres: __NSFW__,
      nativeDates: __NATIVE_DATES__,
      adultOnly: __ADULT_ONLY__, // every title of the site is adult: Hide NSFW hides the whole source
    },
  },

  // The site's own search is a filter of the page that lists every title: so is this one (the list is read once and kept half an hour).
  async search(query, page = 1, orderBy = '') {
    const q = String(query || '').trim().toLowerCase();
    if (q && NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(q)) return empty();
    const index = await seriesIndex();
    if (q) return paged(index.items.filter((i) => i.title.toLowerCase().includes(q)), page);
    if (orderBy === 'title') return paged([...index.items].sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title)), page);
    return paged(await latestItems(), page);
  },

  // Every genre asked for has to be on the title (the tags each title carries): an unknown or never-listed name is nothing.
  async byGenres(genres, orderBy = '', _filters = {}, page = 1) {
    const names = (Array.isArray(genres) ? genres : [genres]).map((g) => String(g || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!names.length || names.some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) return empty();
    const wanted = names.map((g) => String(GENRE_SLUGS[g.toLowerCase()] || '').toLowerCase());
    if (wanted.some((w) => !w)) return empty();
    const index = await seriesIndex();
    let items = index.items.filter((i) => wanted.every((w) => i.tags.includes(w)));
    if (orderBy === 'title') items = [...items].sort((a, b) => a.title.localeCompare(b.title));
    return paged(items, page);
  },

  async trending() {
    return { results: (await latestItems()).slice(0, PER_PAGE).map(strip) };
  },

  async latestUpdates() {
    return { results: (await latestItems()).slice(0, PER_PAGE).map(strip) };
  },

  async popularAllTime() {
    return { results: (await seriesIndex()).items.slice(0, PER_PAGE).map(strip) };
  },

  async mangaDetails(mangaId) {
    const id = String(mangaId || '');
    if (!MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid title id', 400);
    const $ = cheerio.load(await fetchPage(`/series/${id}/`));
    const title = $('div.grid > h1').first().text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (!title) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404); // a 200 that is not a title page
    const genres = $('div:has(> h1) a[href*="genre="]').map((_, a) => $(a).text().replace(/,/g, '').trim()).get().filter(Boolean);
    if (genres.some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
    return {
      id,
      title,
      cover: proxyImg(backgroundOf($('div[class*="photoURL"], div[style*="photoURL"]').first())),
      description: plainText($('#expand_content p').map((_, p) => `<p>${$(p).html()}</p>`).get().join('')),
      status: normalizeStatus(valueOf($, 'Status')),
      genres,
      author: [valueOf($, 'Author'), valueOf($, 'Artist')].filter((v, i, all) => v && all.indexOf(v) === i).join(', '),
      url: `${BASE}/series/${id}/`,
    };
  },

  async chapters(mangaId) {
    const id = String(mangaId || '');
    if (!MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid title id', 400);
    const $ = cheerio.load(await fetchPage(`/series/${id}/`));
    if (!$('div.grid > h1').length) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
    if ($('div:has(> h1) a[href*="genre="]').map((_, a) => $(a).text()).get().some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
    const now = Date.now();
    const chapters = [];
    const rawDates = [];
    const dayOnly = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    $('#chapters > a, #chapters > div').each((_, row) => {
      const $row = $(row);
      // Paid chapters and chapters that are not out yet are not offered.
      if ($row.find('img[alt~="Coin"]').length || $row.find('span').filter((__, s) => /^upcoming$/i.test($(s).text().trim())).length) return;
      const href = $row.is('a') ? $row.attr('href') : $row.find('a[href]').first().attr('href');
      const m = String(href || '').match(/\/chapter\/([^/?#]+)/);
      if (!m || seen.has(m[1]) || !CHAPTER_ID_RE.test(m[1])) return;
      seen.add(m[1]);
      const name = $row.find('.text-sm').first().text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || String($row.attr('title') || m[1]);
      const num = (name.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/) || [])[1] || '';
      chapters.push({ id: m[1], name, title: name, chapter: num, url: `${BASE}/chapter/${m[1]}/`, publishAt: null, pages: [] });
      const dateText = $row.find('.text-xs').first().text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      rawDates.push(toIso(dateText, now));
      dayOnly.push(!/ago/i.test(dateText));
    });
    if (!chapters.length) throw new Error(`${SITE}: no readable chapter found`);
    // A date that is only a day keeps its day; a time of day shared by four or more chapters is a batch import, not a publication time.
    const cleaned = cleanPublishDates(rawDates);
    chapters.forEach((c, i) => { c.publishAt = dayOnly[i] ? rawDates[i] : cleaned[i]; });
    return { chapters }; // newest first, as the site lists them
  },

  async pages(chapterId) {
    const id = String(chapterId || '');
    if (!CHAPTER_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid chapter id', 400); // also refuses ../../etc/passwd
    const html = await fetchPage(`/chapter/${id}/`);
    const $ = cheerio.load(html);
    // The pictures are named by a short id; the host they live on is in the page's own script.
    const host = (/realUrl\s*=\s*`[^`]+\/\/([^/`$]+)/.exec(html) || [])[1];
    const pages = [];
    $('#pages > img').each((_, img) => {
      const uid = String($(img).attr('uid') || '').trim();
      let src = '';
      if (uid && host && /^(?!.*\.\.)[\w-][\w./-]*$/.test(uid)) src = `https://${host}/uploads/${uid}`;
      else if (!uid) src = absUrl($(img).attr('data-src') || $(img).attr('src') || '');
      if (src) pages.push({ index: pages.length, img: proxyImg(src) });
    });
    if (!pages.length) {
      if (LOCKED_RE.test($('body').clone().find('script, style, noscript').remove().end().text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 20000))) throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" is locked on the site`, 403);
      throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" not found`, 404); // 200 with a page that has no pictures
    }
    return { pages };
  },
};
